Vendored from https://github.com/superfly/cr-sqlite at
`8e32195704ccaea8508f7d378e11dc2dc0bb3d2e`, with sqlite-rs-embedded at
`aba562843b26642e2242f8e3388b83a1a2625031`.

Only the native extension's build inputs are included. The unused, removed
`concat_idents` feature attribute is omitted from sqlite3_capi. A workspace
manifest isolates the extension build and pins dependencies in its own lockfile.
The extension's existing unstable features are enabled only in its subprocess
build; the application and synchronization protocol use stable Rust.

The shared library is built for the host and embedded in the executable. No
extension is downloaded at runtime. See cr-sqlite/LICENSE for the upstream license.

The deployed `aarch64-apple-darwin` and `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` targets use
checked-in bindings generated by bindgen 0.68.1 from the vendored
`sqlite3_capi/wrapper.h` (SQLite 3.45.0 headers), with `use_core()`,
`-fvisibility=default`, and the corresponding Clang `--target` option. This
removes the runtime libclang build dependency on those hosts. Other native
targets retain upstream bindgen generation. Regenerate the bindings when
updating these headers and verify the extension on each deployed architecture.
